rope_apply_flat.doc: Rotate `x` in place-equivalent form. Layout is `[token][head][dim]`, row-major.
rope_apply_flat.name: rope_apply_flat

rope_apply_inverse_flat.doc: The exact inverse rotation — negate the angle.
rope_apply_inverse_flat.name: rope_apply_inverse_flat

rope_inv_freq.doc: Inverse frequency per dimension pair: `theta ** (-2i / head_dim)` for i in 0..head_dim/2.
rope_inv_freq.name: rope_inv_freq

rope_inv_freq_llama3.doc: The llama-3.1 "llama3" rope scaling: the base inverse frequency of each dimension pair, adjusted by the standard low/high-frequency-factor interpolation.
rope_inv_freq_llama3.name: rope_inv_freq_llama3

rope_table.doc: Build cos/sin for every (position, pair). Row-major: `pos * n_pairs + pair`.
rope_table.name: rope_table

rope_table_freq_factors.doc: `rope_table` with an EXPLICIT per-pair frequency factor applied to each base inverse frequency: `inv[i] = base_inv[i] / freq_factors[i]`. This is exactly how ggml consumes a GGUF `rope_freqs.weight` tensor (`theta / freq_factor` per pair, see ggml-metal's rope kernels), so a llama.cpp-exported file carrying llama3-scaled factors reproduces those frequencies WITHOUT re-deriving the llama3 parameters from metadata the format does not store. `freq_factors` must hold exactly `head_dim // 2` finite, strictly-positive values; a length mismatch or a non-positive/non-finite factor returns `ATTN_ERR_UNKNOWN_SCALING`. An empty `freq_factors` list is the caller's "no explicit factors" signal and returns `ATTN_ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH` (the plain `rope_table` is the no-scaling path).
rope_table_freq_factors.name: rope_table_freq_factors

rope_table_llama3.doc: `rope_table` with the llama-3.1 "llama3" frequency adjustment applied to every pair -- same Float64, row-major `pos * n_pairs + pair` contract; see `rope_inv_freq_llama3` for the formula and the typed-failure convention. Invalid scaling parameters return `ATTN_ERR_UNKNOWN_SCALING` (a wrong rope silently unscaled is exactly the failure the module docstring calls the most dangerous in the package).
rope_table_llama3.name: rope_table_llama3

rope_theta_agreement.doc: Both frozen theta answers for the same extension, plus their ratio.
rope_theta_agreement.name: rope_theta_agreement

rope_theta_for.doc: The theta this module will use. `-1.0` for an unknown scaling code — never a silent default.
rope_theta_for.name: rope_theta_for

greedy_argmax_flat.name: greedy_argmax_flat

kv_cache_append_flat.doc: `out = cache ++ new_vals`, exact-length on both operands (rule 1). One decode step's worth of freshly-projected, freshly-RoPE'd K (or V) rows, appended to what every earlier step (prefill included) already produced. Called twice per layer per step by `qwen3_generate.mojo` -- once for K, once for V -- never for Q, which is never cached (a decode step's query is always exactly the new token; there is nothing to look back up).
kv_cache_append_flat.name: kv_cache_append_flat
